propositions: A shared ticket store must coordinate N tracker projects and N repos by recording each ticket's project and repos, with the project set owned by the store mapping at `.bridge_state/projects.json` to prevent diff-based deletion of unvisited projects.

Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate all configured projects in a single pass, executing one JQL pair per project and merging enrichment data (parent/comment/issuelink maps) from all projects into a shared snapshot keyed by issue.

Tri-state ticket project field (absent=legacy default, empty=never sync, explicit=sync there) requires zero-event migration via idempotent ensure unit seeding the mapping from current backend project.
Per-ticket project on creation must target the explicit ticket project rather than repo default, while outbound dispatch guard must relax from single project to set membership check.

Multi-project store must carry `multi-project-bridge` capability stamp in `.store-compat.json` `required_capabilities` when mapping holds >1 project, with the stamp and mapping mutation landing in one atomic tracker commit and older binaries refusing writes.
All 14 children including live multi-project rehearsal against two real Jira Cloud projects must complete with zero Jira contamination and 2160-issue volume passing validation.
